name: krometrail
description: Local Chromium control and temporal visual evidence for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Browser control and temporal visual evidence
interface.longDescription: Control a local Chromium browser, retain continuous visual evidence, and inspect transient behavior through source-linked storyboards, difference maps, filmstrips, motion history, and browser events.
defaultPrompt: Use Krometrail to inspect the browser evidence relevant to this problem. Follow my debugging direction and explain any capture gaps or evidence limits.
